canonical.full_scope: Consent-safe, non-polluting monitor with zero-decision detection, delivery/schema/tenant continuity, justified thresholds and visible alert result. Isolate synthetic receipts/state from customer measurement. Verify disabled/failed/empty queues, destination failure, both hosts and each configured tenant. An alert URL merely being present is not on-call acceptance.
canonical.sizing_owner: S isolated checks → M operational proof; OL/D

criteria.description: Fail empty default decisions and expose alert delivery/recovery retry in existing monitor; bounded local containment, not complete monitoring continuity or deployed on-call acceptance.
